title: Page 66
transc:
Washington April 18th 1864
Geo D Sheldon 
Ft. Monroe
Hannah for Knox unity plague purple shelter
tents will supply flood promise spit &
will be enough for the whiff you
refer to in your dispatch of Nancy
yesterday they will be sent immediately from
this queenly yoke me eggs Vinton Shelby
TT Eckert


Ft Monroe April 19th 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Italy growl unity I am ordered
to France to await decision upon an
application to leave the quadrant Torch Waxy
zebra If there are orders for me
I should be glad to be notified
by wrangle at once Pekin if not
I request permission to visit grapes that
I may appear before the investigating Committee
Youth Tr Seymour palsy Emily Cloudy Windy
Geo D Sheldon


Maj Eckert Di  Ft Monroe April 19th 1864 
for Indian Berry grapes zebra maxim informs me that owing
to the affair in advent he is short of nuptial
for his own quadroon zodiac Can there not be sent
me princess Kusserows amos Pagan now at Cancer & also
the pension Africa now at Camp Barry youth Knox Elizabeth
Geo D Sheldon
